name: smwpatches-customizable-bob-omb-and-wiggler-palette-flashing
title: Customizable Bob-omb and Wiggler Palette Flashing
description:
This patch allows you to customize the palettes through which the bob-omb and wiggler flash as well as the rate at which the flash occurs.

The two codes in this patch were originally by Kevin and yoshifanatic. I (DrAnas) simply combined the two codes into a single patch for submission and easier accessibility.
